inputs.text: Support-programme workers at the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth are demanding legally binding job security, not assurances from a government that says it has already met the main demands. Their protest outside the Presidential Palace and 24-hour strike show the imbalance workers face when their livelihoods depend on promises rather than enforceable protections. If the government has delivered, it should be willing to guarantee that security in law.
